dataset: Four complete own-seat normal-opening sequences, variant 0 only: combo, direct attack, negated Hayate stop, Veiler stops Kagari; equal scene weights
contrasts: For each of three development variants, replay both good/bad battle choices and Veiler/Ogre/pass interaction; same root observations; two repetitions plus independent engine audit before training
retention: Frozen starting candidate, full own-seat histories independently rebuilt, KL(current||parent) over legal support, no padding or opponent-seat labels
evaluation: Before and fixed final endpoints: three variants, every opening/later root and four old synthetic fixtures, two repeats plus independent audit; probes variant 0 only
success_gate: All 27 normal task roots and all four original synthetic fixtures succeed, including direct-attack retention; report normal and synthetic separately
selection: Compare fixed 1024 endpoints; 0.25 is primary, 0.05 tests resistance to correcting confident parent errors; no automatic extension or PPO continuation
stop: Invalid engine state, reference contrast failure, input drift, RNN parity failure, nonfinite update or time budget
scope: User-authorized three-capability learnability pilot; fixed legal deals, fixed opponent responses, development families only, no global strategic preference or playing-strength claim
